name: xling-bench
comment: Synthetic RU/EN cross-language bench. 24 invented documents, 12 written only in English and 12 only in Russian, on 24 non-overlapping subjects so no document can answer another's query. Each document carries TWO queries that are translations of each other: one in its own language (control) and one in the other (cross). The measurement is the CONTROL-minus-CROSS gap, never the cross score alone — a low cross score means nothing unless the same question in the document's own language scored higher. Both queries are equally paraphrastic; neither reuses the document's distinctive wording, so the control is not an exact-match freebie.

queries.why: Control: query and document are both EN. Its ONLY purpose is to be the baseline the cross-language twin is read against.
